ops.title: daemonkit: skip the disk re-hash and launchctl check when the live daemon reports the wanted build? (Oct 27 2026)
ops.body: Owner picked: add the fast path. When the running daemon, answering over its code-signed control channel, reports the wanted build, Ensure skips re-hashing the placed binary and the launchctl print verify. The full check still runs on a mismatch, no answer, or first start. Motivation: ~30 ms per cc-present command (placedDigest 12-17 ms, launchd.Verify 15-18 ms).
